name: setGroup
decl: const setGroup = (selector, enabled, root=document) => root.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(el => setEnabled(el, enabled));

name: setEl
decl: const setEl = (id, html) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerHTML = html; };

name: normalizeRecipe
decl: function normalizeRecipe(r){ return Object.assign({}, RECIPE_DEFAULTS, recipeClone(r || {})); }

name: norm
decl: function norm(a){ let t=0; for(const x of a) t+=x; return a.map(x=>t?+(x/t).toFixed(5):0); }

name: inter
decl: function inter(a,b){ let s=0; for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++) s+=Math.min(a[i],b[i]); return s; }

name: loadImage
decl: function loadImage(url){ return new Promise((ok,no)=>{ const i=new Image(); i.onload=()=>ok(i); i.onerror=()=>no(new Error('image decode failed')); i.src=url; }); }

name: sigFromDataUrl
decl: async function sigFromDataUrl(url){ return signature(await loadImage(url),false); }

name: persistRecipe
decl: async function persistRecipe(r){ if(idb) await idbTx('recipes',s=>s.put(r)); else lsWrite(); }

name: setTxt
decl: const setTxt = (id, val) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.textContent = val; };

name: show
decl: function show(){ const d=$('recipe-alpha-display'); if(!d) return; d.textContent = buf ? (buf.length>26 ? '…'+buf.slice(-25) : buf) : ' '; }

name: status
decl: function status(t,bad){ const e=$('recipe-cal-status'); if(!e) return; e.textContent=t; e.style.color=bad?'#FF9B95':''; e.style.borderColor=bad?'#8b2b27':''; }
